title: Black Pepper Rasam
description: A peppery tamarind broth with freshly ground pepper, cumin and coriander, finished with a ghee tempering.
ingredients: A small bunch of fresh coriander leaves (washed)
Tamarind & salt (soaked in water for 1 hour)

steps.title: Prepare spice powder
steps.text: In a grinder, blend black peppercorns, cumin seeds, dried red chilli, asafoetida and fresh coriander leaves into a fine powder.

steps.title: Simmer tamarind base
steps.text: Extract juice from the soaked tamarind and salt. Heat the tamarind water in a pot, add the ground spice powder and let it simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Adjust consistency
steps.text: Add extra water as needed to reach the thickness you like, and mix in the jaggery.

steps.title: Tempering
steps.text: In a small pan, heat the ghee. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter. Pour this tempering into the simmered rasam and turn off the heat.
